description: PAID. Costs one interval of the first machine in the door's ranking that runs it within this server's cap (hosts set their own price; 0.007 USDC an hour today; see charter_offers), paid from this server's own wallet in USDC on Base. Hosts are run by independent operators, not vetted by Charter. Runs your Python 3 script once in a sandbox on a rented machine and returns its stdout, stderr and exit code. NumPy is installed; there is no network and no other package; the script is at most 8 KiB. Most scripts finish in seconds. If it is still running when the wait ends, the leaseId comes back and charter_lease collects the output for free.

script.description: the Python 3 source, at most 8192 bytes

waitSeconds.description: how long to wait for the job before handing back the leaseId (default 40, under most clients' 60 s tool timeout)

name: charter_run_python
title: Run a Python script on a rented machine
